method.scope: Default /v1 request.get, including failures. Full pre-change campaign plus complete final-build recheck and a fresh baseline confirmation on the first three targets.
method.timing: Client wall time including API overhead and response transfer; verified responses only for medians.
method.resources: Application plus Redis, cgroup samples every 250 ms. CPU includes failed work. Memory is a conservative sum of per-request application and Redis peaks, not process RSS.
limitations: Small samples of changing public sites; first request timings vary with target protection and network state.
First visits still solve challenges in the browser when required. Named sessions and browser captures do not use HTTP replay.
Discogs search remains an existing delivery timeout; all failures are retained.
No attempt is made to infer that every JavaScript application is fully rendered. Use skipHttp or a browser content wait for rendered content.

method.cache: Redis for TRAWL; cleared before each site
method.cpuAndMemoryScope: Application container; TRAWL Redis costs are also recorded separately
